text:
**Subject: Launch Position and Next Step**

Hi Avery,

Quick update on our launch position.

The October 8 launch was tentative. The security review will now complete October 12 at the earliest, and release requires completed approval. We will not confirm a new production date until the review closes, as remediation may be needed.

The team remains confident. Work is on track, and the only shift is the approval timeline—not the quality of what we've built.

We can still hold a staging demo on October 8 using synthetic data. This lets you see progress without depending on the security review.

Nia owns the security review. You decide whether to accept the staging demo.

**Action needed:** Please confirm by [date] whether you want the October 8 staging demo. If yes, we'll prepare with synthetic data. If no, we'll hold and update you when the review completes.

Happy to walk through any of this.

Jordan
Engagement Lead
